notes.front: On which form do Armed Forces members figure the moving expense deduction?
notes.back: Form 3903, one for each move.
notes.explanation: The deduction is for qualified expenses that exceed reimbursements and excluded allowances.
notes.source: Publication 3 (2025), Armed Forces' Tax Guide, “Moving Expenses”, p. 13
notes.evidence: Figure moving expense deductions on Form 3903.

notes.front: An active-duty sailor is ordered from one permanent base to another; qualified costs are $4,000 and the allowances excluded from income are $3,000. What can be deducted?
notes.back: $1,000, figured on Form 3903.
notes.explanation: A move between permanent posts is a permanent change of station; only costs above excluded allowances are deductible: $4,000 − $3,000 = $1,000.
notes.source: Publication 3 (2025), Armed Forces' Tax Guide, “Moving Expenses”, p. 13
notes.evidence: provide information on how to figure your deduction for qualified expenses that exceed your reimbursements and allowances

notes.front: Whose health insurance can the self-employed health insurance deduction cover?
notes.back: You, your spouse, your dependents, and a child under 27 at year end even if not your dependent.
notes.explanation: It includes medical, dental and vision insurance and qualified long-term care insurance.
notes.source: Instructions for Form 1040 and 1040-SR (2025), “Line 17 Self-Employed Health Insurance Deduction”, p. 94
notes.evidence: You may be able to deduct the amount you paid for health insurance (which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance and qualified long-term care insurance) for yourself, your spouse, and your dependents.

notes.front: A self-employed parent pays health insurance for a 25-year-old child who isn't her dependent. Can the premiums count toward the self-employed health insurance deduction?
notes.back: Yes. A child under 27 at the end of 2025 can be covered even if not a dependent.
notes.explanation: The Form 1040 instructions extend coverage to such a child.
notes.source: Instructions for Form 1040 and 1040-SR (2025), “Line 17 Self-Employed Health Insurance Deduction”, p. 94
notes.evidence: The insurance can also cover your child who was under age 27 at the end of 2025, even if the child wasn't your dependent.

notes.front: Under what must the health insurance be established for the self-employed health insurance deduction?
notes.back: Under your business, or the S corporation in which you were a more-than-2% shareholder.
notes.explanation: The deduction worksheet starts from premiums for coverage established under the business.
notes.source: Instructions for Form 1040 and 1040-SR (2025), “Self-Employed Health Insurance Deduction Worksheet”, p. 94
notes.evidence: Enter the total amount paid in 2025 for health insurance coverage established under your business (or the S corporation in which you were a more-than-2% shareholder)

notes.source: Instructions for Form 1040 and 1040-SR (2025), “Educator Expenses”, p. 93
notes.evidence: If you and your spouse are filing jointly and both of you were eligible educators, the maximum deduction is $600. However, neither spouse can de

notes.front: An eligible educator filing single paid $450 of qualified classroom expenses in 2025. What is the deduction?
notes.explanation: The deduction is limited to $300 per eligible educator.
notes.source: Instructions for Form 1040 and 1040-SR (2025), “Educator Expenses”, p. 93
notes.evidence: you can deduct on line 11 up to $300 of qualified expenses you paid in 2025.

notes.front: When working out taxable social security benefits, what must you do first if the instructions have you enter a write-in adjustment on Schedule 1, line 24z?
notes.back: Figure that write-in adjustment first.
notes.explanation: The Form 1040 instructions tell you to figure the line 24z write-in before completing the social security benefits worksheet.
notes.source: Instructions for Form 1040 and 1040-SR (2025), “Social Security Benefits Worksheet”, p. 32
notes.evidence: If the instructions for Schedule 1, line 24z, have you enter a write-in adjustment on line 24z, figure that write-in before completing this worksheet
